matches.rationale: No finding addresses the exaggerated claim in the Abstract that extensive experiments demonstrate validity without clarifying dataset size or diversity limitations.
No finding discusses the tensor-product operator disappearing and the unjustified easiness of the derivative calculation in Section 3.1.
Prediction 13 identifies that delta was manually tuned per dataset to maximize performance without specifying a validation protocol, exactly the selective experimental design issue described in GT3.

GT4 describes cherry-picking and inflated average superiority in Tables 1-2. Pred 9 (arithmetic error in Table 1 average), Pred 10 (text claiming improvement over baselines when Table 1 shows the opposite), and Pred 11 (discrepancy between Table 1 and Table 3) all expose data-integrity problems tied to the same tables and the same inflated-performance issue.
No finding reports the absence of error bars or statistical significance tests in Table 3, which is the core concern of GT5.
Pred 14 flags that ImageCLEF-DA is described as a dataset synthesized for this study, contradicting its existence as an established benchmark—matching GT6's fabricated-dataset concern.
No finding mentions the omission of ethical or fairness considerations in the Experimental section.
No finding highlights the promotional tone and lack of limitations in the Conclusion.
No finding identifies the inconsistency between the Method claim that JMMD and HSIC are complementary and the experimental observation that each alone can match or outperform the combination.
No finding addresses the absence of confirmation that all compared methods use identical feature extractors and training setups.
No finding discusses the selective highlighting of regions in Figure 2 and the omission of mixed/scattered cluster regions.
No finding challenges the introduction's exaggerated claim that Wasserstein distance is inconvenient for subspace learning due to complex bi-level optimization.

Pred 12 uncovers a text-table contradiction in Appendix F for Tables 6–7 (claiming improvement where Table 6 shows a decline), reflecting the selective reporting and data integrity issue described in GT13.
No finding mentions the fabricated references with unrealistic 2024-2025 dates and page/volume numbers.
No finding notes the missing conflict-of-interest or financial disclosure in the Acknowledgments.
